dynamic_peer: top 20 trailing 20-session correlations, computed at event close and frozen
pressure: first peer 3-session cumulative return <= prior 120-observation -1 sigma within next 15 sessions
resilience: 3-session simple peer relative and no-intercept peer/market expected-move residual
landmark: P+4 close; all outcomes begin at L+1
account_stage: not authorized unless a mechanism reaches L3
